title: At School and University
ringkas: Bertanya kepada guru, kerja kelompok, dan jadwal
goals: **bertanya kepada guru** atau dosen dengan sopan

lesson.text: Di sekolah dan kampus kamu perlu bertanya, meminta penjelasan, dan membagi tugas. Gunakan kalimat sopan dan jelas.

lesson.title: Ungkapan berguna
table: [[I suggest that we ... / Why don't we ...?]]
[[When is the test? / What time does class start?]]

lines.en: Why don't we divide the work?

lesson.title: Cara berlatih
lesson.text: Siapkan tiga kalimat bertanya kepada guru (*Could you explain ...?*) dan gunakan di kelas atau dalam latihan suara.

items: Bertanya kepada guru: [[Excuse me, could you explain ...?]]
Meminta mengulang: [[Could you repeat that, please?]]
Mengajukan ide: [[I suggest that we ... / Why don't we ...?]]
Membagi tugas: [[I'll do ... Can you do ...?]]
Menanyakan jadwal: [[When is the test? / What time does class start?]]

practice.id: Katakan kamu belum paham dan minta penjelasan.
answers: Yes, I don't understand this part. Could you explain it again?
Yes, could you explain number three, please?
Sorry, I'm confused. Could you repeat that?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Yes, I don't understand this part. Could you explain it again?  atau  Yes, could you explain number three, please?  atau  Sorry, I'm confused. Could you repeat that?

practice.q: Now open your books to page twenty.
turns: Now open your books to page twenty.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Could you repeat that, please?  atau  Sorry, which page?  atau  Excuse me, page what?
Contoh balasan: I'll write the report.  atau  I can do it.  atau  Let me write it.
Contoh balasan: Sure, I'll find them tonight.  atau  OK, no problem.  atau  Yes, I'll do it.

practice.q: Do you know when the test is?
turns: Do you know when the test is?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: The test is on Friday.  atau  It's on Friday.  atau  I think it's on Friday.

practice.q: What is the homework for tomorrow?
turns: What is the homework for tomorrow?
answers: We have to do the exercise on page ten.
It's the exercise on page ten.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: We have to do the exercise on page ten.  atau  It's the exercise on page ten.  atau  Exercise one on page ten.

answers: I can lend you my notebook.
Do you want to see my notes?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: You can borrow my notes.  atau  I can lend you my notebook.  atau  Do you want to see my notes?

practice.id: Minta maaf dan jelaskan bus terlambat.
answers: I'm sorry. The bus was late.
Excuse me, the traffic was bad.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I'm sorry. The bus was late.  atau  Sorry, I missed the bus.  atau  Excuse me, the traffic was bad.

answers: Good morning, everyone. Today I'll talk about recycling.
Hello, everyone. My topic is healthy food.
Good morning. I'm going to present our project.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Good morning, everyone. Today I'll talk about recycling.  atau  Hello, everyone. My topic is healthy food.  atau  Good morning. I'm going to present our project.

practice.q: Thank you. Are there any questions?
turns: Thank you. Are there any questions?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Thank you for listening.  atau  Thank you for your attention.  atau  Thanks, everyone.

answers: Could I use your eraser, please?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Can I borrow an eraser?  atau  Do you have an eraser?  atau  Could I use your eraser, please?

practice.q: Where can you find more information?
turns: Where can you find more information?
answers: We can find it in the library.
In the library or on the internet.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: We can find it in the library.  atau  In the library or on the internet.  atau  At the library.

answers: Good idea. Let's meet in the library.
Sure, how about after school in the library?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Good idea. Let's meet in the library.  atau  Sure, how about after school in the library?  atau  Yes, I'd like that.

answers: Thank you, I worked hard on it.
Thanks! I'm glad you like it.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Thank you, I worked hard on it.  atau  Thanks! I'm glad you like it.  atau  Thank you very much.

practice.q: Pilih ungkapan sopan untuk meminta pengulangan:
practice.exp: Jawaban yang tepat: **Could you repeat that, please?**
